_doc: Game speed. Speeds at or below 1x are never locked (an accessibility option). Faster speeds are unlocked by progress; `unlocks` lists the hand-made ones, `generated` makes the speed 2^k for every k >= from forever. req.kind: level {value} | rebirths {value: lifetime rebirths} | layerCount {layer, value: prestiges of that layer} | tree {layer, node, level} | upgrade {id, level} (shop upgrades reset on rebirth, so they re-lock). Speed only scales the simulation: never the real clock, saves or offline progress. Add an unlock by adding an object here.
